description: Client-side script for Expense Claim form in ERPNext, managing form behaviors, data fetching, calculations, and UI interactions.

methods.name: set_title
methods.description: Sets the title of the Expense Claim form based on employee and task.

methods.name: get_advances
methods.description: Fetches employee advances related to the expense claim.

methods.name: calculate_total
methods.description: Calculates total claimed and sanctioned amounts from expense details.

methods.name: calculate_grand_total
methods.description: Calculates the grand total including taxes and deductions.

methods.name: update_employee_advance_claimed_amount
methods.description: Allocates grand total amount across employee advances.

methods.name: make_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates a payment entry or bank entry related to the expense claim.

methods.name: set_child_cost_center
methods.description: Sets the cost center for each expense detail if not already set.

methods.name: get_taxes
methods.description: Calculates taxes for the expense claim.
